system.description:
Built on Project FU's Loremaster.

FREE BENEFITS
  • increased maximum Mind Points — activated.

(House note: benefits adopted from Project FU's Loremaster counterpart — FU auto-applies the class math; the mechanical fields are activated on the sheet. Rippers handles class identity through the Guise.)

ARCHIVIST SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000019]{Flash of Insight} 【Max SL 3】

On a Result of 13+ on a Check to investigate a creature, item or location (Study included): bank up to (SL) questions about it, asked now or later, answered truthfully by the GM. Once per subject.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000020]{Focused} 【Max SL 5】

Permanently +(SL × 3) max MP, and +(SL) to Open Checks using (INS + INS).

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000021]{Knowledge Is Power} 【Max SL 1】

Accuracy Checks may replace one Attribute die with Insight.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000022]{Quick Assessment} 【Max SL 6】

Start of conflict: spend up to (SL × 5) MP; every 5 MP reveals one Trait, or one named damage type's Affinity, of a creature you can see. Pressure points count as Traits for this Skill.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000023]{Trained Memory} 【Max SL 1】

Perfect recall of any scene visited within the past week — revisit it in your mind and investigate it again, Flash of Insight included.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000024]{Technical Mind} 【Max SL 5】

When you initiate a Project, its initial cost is reduced by (SL × 50) zenit. The printed "you may initiate Projects" line is struck — Project access comes only from the benefit-pool pick.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000025]{Unfettered Brilliance} 【Max SL 4】

At session start, roll your INS die (SL) times and bank the results; when another creature you can see performs a Check, replace one of its dice with an unused banked value. Extra dice cost 500z, or no armour/shields this session, or erasing one emotion from a Bond — each option once.
